claim: The recordanelle is a single-component synthetic organelle of a mitochondrial membrane anchor, a condensate assembler and a poly(A)-binding protein
quote:
Recordanelles are composed
of a mitochondrial membrane anchor, a condensate assembler and a
poly(A)-binding protein.

claim: Recordanelles sample up to 90% of endogenous mRNAs and protect them over several days
quote:
a sampling of up to 90% of all
endogenous mRNAs and protect them over several days

claim: DNA-based molecular recording has been largely confined to prokaryotes and small target gene sets
quote: yet have been largely confined to prokaryotes and/or a small set of target genes8,9

claim: MCP and PCP were used as sequence-specific RBDs binding ms2 and pp7 stem loops
quote:
we used MCP and PCP, which
specifically bind ms2 and pp7 stem loops, respectively13,14

claim: The mitochondrial anchor is the first 70 amino acids of human TOM20
quote: we used the first 70 aa of the human mitochondrial protein TOM20, which has been described previously15,16

claim: FISH showed mCherry::ms2 enriched in MCP-containing but not PCP-containing recordanelles, and the reverse for mCherry::pp7
quote:
Swapping mCherry::ms2
for mCherry::pp7 led to mCherry RNA localization exclusively
within PCP-containing recordanelles.

claim: qPCR on the mitochondrial fraction showed 3-fold to 11-fold enrichment of mCherry::ms2 over a mock control
quote: an efficiency ranging from 3-fold to 11-fold compared to a mock control

claim: Selectivity, as the ratio of mCherry::ms2 to EGFP::pp7, ranged from 1.2-fold to 6-fold for MCP-based recordanelles
quote: EGFP::pp7 mRNAs and found values ranging from 1.2-fold to 6-fold

claim: Nonspecific RNA binding appeared without an RBD for the full-length proteins EWSR1 and FUSQG, which carry their own RBDs
quote:
in the absence of an RBD, we observed nonspecific RNA
binding in the case of EWSR1 and FUSQG, which we suspect is because
of these full-length proteins containing their own RBDs

claim: TAF15N and FUSN, IDRs without C-terminal RBDs, lacked nonspecific binding activity
quote:
appeared to lack this nonspecific
binding activity

claim: Changing the RBD from MCP to PCP switched enrichment from mCherry::ms2 to EGFP::pp7, showing the recordanelle is tunable
quote: switched the RNA enrichment from mCherry:ms2 to EGFP::pp7, indicating that the recordanelle can be tuned by altering the RBD

claim: With MCP- or PCP-based recordanelles there were no differentially expressed genes at the full cell level versus the RBD-less control
quote:
not observe any differentially expressed genes (DEGs) at the full cell
level compared to ∆RBD

claim: Within the recordanelle fraction the targeted RNA was among the top (MCP) or the only (PCP) significantly enriched gene
quote:
the targeted RNA (that is, mCherry::ms2 or EGFP::pp7) was among
the top (MCP) or the only (PCP) significantly enriched gene(s)

claim: RBDs targeting the 5′ cap and poly(A) tail were tested to generalize recruitment, with the assembler fixed as TAF15N
quote:
we initially
used TAF15N as it exhibited moderate specific RNA enrichment and
showed no nonspecific binding in previous assays without additional
RBDs

claim: Of the mRNA-binder recordanelles only PABPN1 failed to localize to mitochondria
quote:
While one recordanelle did not
localize as anticipated (PABPN1), all others colocalized with a mitochondrial marker

claim: LARP1/4A and PABPC1/4 variants recruited mRNA to the mitochondrial fraction up to 15-fold
quote: showed consistent and efficient mRNA recruitment within the mitochondrial fraction up to 15-fold

claim: FUSQG was best for specific stem-loop recruitment, but TAF15N bound reporter and housekeeping RNAs most for generalized recruitment
quote:
Whereas FUSQG was the most efficient at specific RNA
recruitment when coupled with the stem-loop binders MCP and PCP,
in these generalized mRNA recruitment experiments, TAF15N exhibited
the highest binding of the reporter RNAs and the housekeeping RNA

claim: Synthetic RNA spike-ins were used for accurate global quantification because a large fraction of the transcriptome was expected to bind
quote: we used synthetic RNA spike-ins to enable accurate global quantification of RNA enrichment38

claim: 64% (FUSQG) and 90% (TAF15N) of expressed genes were enriched in recordanelles against a nonbinding control, versus under 0.1% without an RBD
quote:
that 64% (FUSQG) and 90% (TAF15N) of genes expressed within
HEK293T cells were enriched within the recordanelles compared to
a nonbinding control

claim: 64-90% means transcripts are represented in the recordanelle, not that recordanelles bind 64-90% of all RNA in the cell
quote:
this does not indicate that the
recordanelles are bound to 64–90% of all RNA in the cell but, rather,
that 64–90% of transcripts are represented in the recordanelles

claim: Enriched RNAs reflected cytoplasmic content, with the few discordant transcripts being nuclear (e.g. Xist) or mitochondrial
quote:
The few depleted or
enriched transcripts within the mitochondrial fraction compared to
the whole cell correspond to nuclear (for example, the lncRNA Xist)
or mitochondrial RNAs

claim: In the Dox reporter line, transiently induced mCherry::ms2 returns to baseline after 1 day
quote:
when exposed to a transient Dox
stimulus, mCherry::ms2 is robustly expressed but then returns to baseline levels after 1 day

claim: PCP, MCP, LARP1 or LARP4A constructs gave full-cell transcript recovery around 0.07, like the mock control
quote:
led to a transcript recovery at the full
cell level of around 0.07, which was similar to the mock control

claim: PABPC1/4-based recordanelles gave 2-4-fold higher transcript recovery after 1 day, with transcripts still detectable after 2 days
quote:
the PABPC1/4-based recordanelles led to 2–4-fold
higher transcript recovery after 1 day

claim: MCP-containing recordanelles bound mCherry::ms2 robustly yet did not protect it better than a nonbinding PCP control
quote:
One surprising result from this experiment was the fact that a
subset of the recordanelles that we previously showed could recruit
RNAs (LARP4A, LARP1 and MCP) did not protect mCherry::ms2 any
better than a nonbinding PCP control.

claim: Protection may depend on where the RBD binds: MCP binds before the poly(A) tail while PABPC4 proteins bind the tail directly
quote: whereas MCP binds before the poly(A) tail,

claim: In recordanelleV1 and V2 conditions mCherry::ms2 was significantly protected at full cell and mitochondrial levels after 2 days
quote:
we observed significant mCherry::ms2
protection at the full cell (P = 0.0009 and 0.0106, respectively) and
mitochondrial (P < 0.0001) levels

claim: recordanelleV2 is the superior architecture because it records the transient RNA without raising its initial expression level
quote:
Because
recordanelleV2 records this transiently expressed RNA without altering its initial expression level, it represents the superior architecture.

claim: Two representative ISGs, IFIT1 and IFI44L, were robustly expressed after 20 h of IFNB in all recordanelle conditions
quote:
we observed robust expression of the two representative
ISGs—IFIT1 and IFI44L

claim: In control cells the ISG signal decayed completely 2 days after IFNB removal, while recordanelleV1/V2 cells retained it
quote:
Under control conditions, the ISG signal decayed completely and
was indistinguishable from a control that had never been exposed
to IFNB

claim: In recordanelleV1 cells ISG detection sometimes increased from day 0 to day 2, specific to IFNB and absent for YWHAZ
quote:
ISG detection was not only maintained but increased
from day 0 to 2 after IFNB removal

claim: Without passaging, ISGs were still recorded after 5 days; in passaged cells the signal was lost from day 5 onward
quote:
In passaged cells,
recordanelles capture ISGs 3–4 days after stimulus removal but the
signal is lost from day 5 onward.

claim: Cell division and growth dilute the recorded information
quote:
This indicates that cell division and
growth contribute to the dilution of the recorded information.

claim: In controls the IFNB differential response was undetectable 2 days later for all but two genes, IFI6 and IRF9
quote:
The
two genes, IFI6 or IRF9, either exhibited the highest initial induction
or are known to have prolonged expression after type I and II IFN
stimulation39.

claim: recordanelleV2 cells retained all differentially expressed genes, that is 100% recall, over time
quote:
cells expressing recordanelleV2 retained
all DEGs (that is, 100% recall) throughout time

claim: Gene Ontology analysis of DEGs retained by recordanelleV2 reconstructed a detailed picture of the historical IFNB response
quote:
we can reconstruct
a detailed picture of the (historical) IFNB response, as indicated by a
Gene Ontology term analysis of DEGs retained by recordanelleV2

claim: General mRNA recording is diminished when TAF15N is removed from recordanelleV2, though specific mRNAs can be recruited without an assembler
quote:
general mRNA
recording is diminished when TAF15N is removed from recordanelleV2

claim: Proteomics showed ISGs induced at day 0 returned to baseline by day 2 except RIGI and ISG15, with V2 indistinguishable from the control
quote:
all but two proteins returned
to baseline (except RIGI and ISG15) and recordanelleMCP and recordanelleV2 were indistinguishable

claim: recordanelleV1 and V2 did not significantly alter ATP production, apoptosis, mitochondrial membrane potential or aerobic metabolism
quote:
We first determined that recordanelleV1 and recordanelleV2 did
not significantly alter ATP production

claim: Single-cell RNA-seq revealed cluster 6, the IFNB response cluster, which emerged only on IFNB stimulation
quote:
Dimensionality
reduction revealed a distinct cell cluster (cluster 6) that emerged exclusively upon IFNB stimulation and was entirely absent under unstimulated conditions on day 0

claim: Among IFNB-stimulated cells at day 2, only recordanelleV2 retained a substantial proportion of cells in the IRC
quote: among IFNB-stimulated cells at day 2, only recordanelleV2 retained a substantial proportion of cells within the IRC

claim: An ISG module showed the signature disappeared by day 2 in recordanelleMCP cells but was retained in recordanelleV2 cells
quote:
Stimulated cells expressing recordanelleMCP exhibited a substantial
ISG signature at day 0 that disappeared completely 2 days after IFNB
removal

claim: Transcriptional recorders are by their nature perturbations: transgene burden, mitochondrial occupancy, unnatural RNA interactions, RNA depletion and thermodynamic costs
quote:
These perturbations include the burden of transgene expression, occupancy of the
mitochondrial membrane and its immediate surroundings, unnatural
interactions with the RNAs they track, depletion of RNAs from the
cellular pool and thermodynamic costs of information storage.

claim: The recordanelle stores unmodified molecules in a compartment that is easy to extract, unlike DNA/RNA/protein-modifying recorders
quote:
our approach
differs in that it functions by continuously storing unmodified biological molecules within a protective intracellular compartment

claim: The recordanelle needs only one protein of about 91 kDa (2.5 kb), deliverable by lentivirus or AAV
quote:
they
only require the expression of a single protein of approximately 91 kDa
(2.5 kb)

claim: Recordanelles could profile an RBD's specificity in living cells, an alternative to RIP-seq and CLIP-seq
quote:
we demonstrated that the recordanelles
could be used to profile the specificity of an RBD in living cells

claim: recordanelleV1 may be used to sustain and amplify intracellular signals because it facilitates translation of recorded RNAs
quote:
we showed that recordanelleV1 may facilitate translation of
the recorded RNAs, which led to amplified downstream signaling in
the IFNB stimulation experiments

claim: TimeVault uses free-floating vault particles tested mainly for 24-h snapshots; recordanelles continuously sample over arbitrary windows
quote:
Whereas TimeVaults use free-floating vault particles that have been predominately
tested for capturing 24-h expression snapshots; recordanelles use
membrane-anchored biomolecular condensates to continuously
record expression.
